- scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:646-650 | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The `exec_error` path still reads marker/fingerprint violation files even though `_build_retry_prompt` has already short-circuited and will not use them.
  WHY: Those reads can refer to stale data from an earlier attempt and do not affect the rendered retry prompt, so the branch is dead code that may mislead maintainers.
- scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:661-668 | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The timeout retry log claims it is rendering a timeout-aware reflexion prompt even when `_build_retry_prompt` falls back to the original prompt verbatim.
  WHY: If the timeout prelude template is missing or integration sync is off, the model receives the unmodified prompt while the log says otherwise.
- scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:674-676 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The default retry log says it rebuilt a reflexion prompt even when `_build_retry_prompt` may have fallen back to the original prompt verbatim.
  WHY: The log can imply validation data was injected when the prelude was skipped, so the message does not match the actual prompt content.
- scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:685-685 | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The `timeout` invocation can be missed if codex handles SIGTERM and exits 0 before the wrapper records a non-zero status.
  WHY: In that path `_codex_exit` stays 0, so the timeout classification block is skipped.
- scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:693-698 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The `_codex_exit` capture and timeout classification depend on `timeout` returning non-zero, so a graceful 0 exit after SIGTERM can bypass timeout-specific retry handling.
  WHY: If codex exits 0 after receiving the timeout signal, the wrapper treats the attempt as non-timeout and can proceed with the wrong retry path.
